title: feat: wolfHSM backend (wp11_backend_wolfhsm.c)
description: The wolfHSM backend is the most strategically important planned feature. It routes PKCS#11 sign/verify/decrypt calls through the wolfCrypt WH_DEV_ID device callback to a wolfHSM server, enabling the full chain: application → wolfP11 PKCS#11 → wolfCrypt callback → wolfHSM RPC → secure core or TEE. Without this, wolfP11 cannot serve the embedded and HSM-backed use cases that are wolfSSL's primary market. This epic implements src/wp11_backend_wolfhsm.c using the wolfHSM client API, following the structure of wp11_backend_usb_flash.c and registering via the wp11_backend_ops_t dispatch table.
